notes.title: Windows patch 0.9.2
notes.content: Fixed graphics and sound issues, and maybe the leaderboards (I noticed Steam leaderboards had stopped working for me, so I updated steamapi.dll's and my Steam client and It started working again)

notes.title: 2021/2 Update
notes.content:
This is the first feedback-based update to include major changes and additions requested by players.

Changes

 Connection guides replaced with better ones. No more auto-rotating stuff.
 Old online high scores are gone, now using Steam leaderboards. 


New

 Ternary (instead of binary) computer Cellular Automata / Game of Life simulator based on alphanumeric codings. 
 Binary and Octal computer CA / GoL simulator based on I Ching hexagrams. 
 Gematria calculator/navigator/translator module, to explore word value connections.


Windows version available now, Mac version will be added later.
